CustomField.description: SFDC-366. Unit of Measure booked on this order line. BLANK MEANS THE LINE INHERITS Product2.QuantityUnitOfMeasure - every reader must coalesce. Populated from QuoteLineItem.UoM__c by the Quote_AfterSave_SOFHandler flow at order creation, and carried onto child ramp orders by RampOrderService (which clones only the fields its SOQL loads). Blank on every order migrated from BOSS; correcting those is a separate data patch that is blocked on a BOSS export.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Unit this line's quantity is expressed in. Blank means the product's own unit is used.
CustomField.label: UoM
